decision: After publication, consider a separately registered single-callback CPU scoring diagnosis using the two fixed traces, with no new game, official replay or training.
basis: The post-result pair showed same-input PLANT choices assigned to different units, but did not retain callback ordinal. Reconstruct that identity from both already accepted traces before scoring; do not infer the identity from only one trace without checking.
constraints: Freeze source, model and both trace identities; one bounded CPU forward on at most 8192 candidate rows and one decode per trace. Preserve the existing model and all history; individual features, candidate IDs and logits stay local.
interpretation: This can validate model ordering at a single post-result callback only. It cannot identify causal features, prove economic effect, establish generalization or justify promotion. No new training, PPO, DAgger or online submission.
